observations.why: Imperative directive issued in the present, targeting an irrealis desired state of erasure; the command itself is abstract—no specific event referenced, only a category of knowledge to remove.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative seeking an irrealis future state of removal, but anchored in concrete named artifacts (Kestrelwood spectrograph, 88.4 MHz) and a particular person (Quill Ashgrove).
Assertive claim about a past non-event presented as settled fact (realis), tied to a concrete entity (the observatory, 'it').
